native_context: Assessment scope, trust-boundary routing and completion ledger
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.source_trace: Map actual assets, actors, existing authority and required invariants before selecting checks.
controls.controlled_verification: Reconcile a concrete proposed action with the supplied policy, environment and evidence; do not claim it was executed.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Authorization and coverage cannot be inferred from a template or hostname match alone.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Deliver an honest coverage/action ledger with specific missing checks, appropriate routes and preserved existing authorization.

coverage_unit: One workflow reconciliation, not a technical security control or measured coverage.
